text: {"label":"Behavior Analysis in Child Health and Welfare","definition":"Broad applications of behavior analysis to children's health, rights, safety, and clinical services, including pediatric care, neurodevelopmental disorders, service quality and medical necessity, treatment integrity, and practitioner decision-making.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Covers child services at a broad, systemic level rather than parent-involved early intervention and rapport, preschool skill-building, or classroom behavior-management interventions."}
